base_path.description: The absolute directory the workspaces are laid out under, one subdirectory per workspace name; outside the colony root, and granted as `sandbox.filesystem.write` in the same override. Empty or relative answers `no_base_path`.

exec_allow.description: The program names `ws_exec` may start (argv[0], exactly). Empty refuses every program with `not_allowed`.

auto_adopt.description: argv prefixes, word by word, whose `modified` files are taken over at once after a run that exited 0; `created` and `deleted` stay proposals.

ignore.description: Globs over directory-relative paths the scan after a run leaves out (`**` crosses directories); a `.git` segment at any depth is left out regardless.

description.purpose: Lays a workspace out (`ws_materialize`: `ws_tree`, then `raw` for every file whose version moved; a file a program changed and nobody adopted is `dirty` and never overwritten unless `force`), runs `ws_exec` (argv[0] checked against `exec_allow` before anything happens, the directory laid out, the program handed to `./run`, the directory read once afterwards) and takes changes over (`auto_adopt`, `ws_adopt`) through the space's `in_write` with the workspace.
description.use_when: Inside a projection only, behind `in_proj` and `in_answer`.
description.not_in_scope: No program runs here (that is `./run`), no store access to the file space, no path outside `<base_path>/<ws>/`.
description.emits_meaning: `mat_store` between phases (`phase` `<kind>|<job>`), `in_ws`/`in_read`/`in_write` to the space (`op_id` `mat:<job>:<n>`), `in_run` to `./run`, `answer` once per request.
description.consumes_meaning: A request on `in_proj`, the space's answers on `in_answer`, `./run`'s `ran`, the store's answers to its own bundles.
